title: selaginella flabellata var. brevispica
intro: Selaginella flabellata var. brevispica, commonly known as the Short-awned Spoon Fern, is a type of plant belonging to the family Selaginellaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids present in the plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
